# Promobeez

> Barter marketplace connecting local businesses with nano and micro creators
> (500+ followers) in Helsinki. Businesses post an offer — a meal, a service —
> creators with local audiences apply. The business pays for a plan to unlock contact
> details. On paid plans, Promobeez takes no commission on the barter itself.

Operated by Daring Spirit Oy, Helsinki, Finland. Milan waiting list open for Italian readers.

## Research
- [Promobeez SMM Awards](https://www.promobeez.com/promobeez-smm-awards): Data-only social media awards for local businesses, by industry and city, every quarter. Current edition: restaurants and cafes in Helsinki, Q3 2026. Winners, method in brief, and a form to check where an Instagram account would rank.
- [Best restaurant social media in Helsinki, Q3 2026](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/best-restaurant-social-media-helsinki-q3-2026): Data-only awards and original dataset. 1,114 venues, 509 Instagram accounts, 246 scored; overall winner and best chain account Friends & Brgrs (92.2), five district winners (Savoy 91.2 top local venue), Quiet Climb special award (Ekeko Restobar), city top 10, engagement benchmarks by account size and zone, full scoring methodology.
- [Promobeez vs CastersApp](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/promobeez-vs-castersapp): CastersApp runs managed UGC and influencer campaigns with a campaign manager and a 12-month non-circumvention rule. Promobeez is a self-serve barter marketplace from €15 where the creator contact is yours. Model, cost, rules and fit compared.
- [Promobeez vs Vaiku](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/promobeez-vs-vaiku): Vaiku runs paid influencer campaigns from €149 a month. Promobeez is a barter marketplace for local venues from €15. Pricing per creator worked out, cash vs barter, tracking and fit compared.
- [Promobeez vs Invited Agency](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/promobeez-vs-invited-agency): Invited Agency runs influencer campaigns and PR events for you, priced per project. Promobeez is a self-serve barter marketplace from €15. Model, price, control and fit compared.
- [Barter collab platforms in Europe: 2026 country map](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/barter-collab-platforms-europe-map): Interactive map and scored ranking of local-business barter platforms in 19 European countries incl. UK; 25 markets with no dedicated platform.
- [Why audiences trust small creators more than brand ads](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/why-audiences-trust-small-creators-more-than-brands): Evidence review — Nielsen, Edelman 2026, persuasion knowledge, peer-reviewed micro-influencer studies, revenue efficiency.
- [How to choose a local creator](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-local-creator): Playbook — commercially relevant reach, 10-factor checklist, barter sizing, KKV disclosure, measurement.
- [Influencer marketing disclosure in Finland](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/influencer-marketing-disclosure-finland): English guide to KKV 2025 influencer labeling rules.
- [How to promote a restaurant in Helsinki](https://www.promobeez.com/blog/how-to-promote-a-restaurant-in-helsinki): 2026 playbook — Google Business Profile, AI search visibility, review velocity, Helsinki seasonality, creator barter, KKV and Alcohol Act rules.

## Suomeksi
- [Promobeez SMM Awards](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/promobeez-smm-awards): Pelkkään dataan perustuva somepalkinto toimialoittain ja neljänneksittäin; Helsingin ravintolat Q3/2026.
- [Helsingin paras ravintola-some Q3/2026](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/helsingin-paras-ravintola-some-q3-2026): Pelkkään dataan perustuva palkinto: aluevoittajat, kärkikymmenikkö, vertailuluvut ja menetelmä.
- [Promobeez vs CastersApp](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/promobeez-vs-castersapp): CastersApp toteuttaa hallinnoituja UGC- ja vaikuttajakampanjoita kampanjapäällikön kanssa ja 12 kuukauden kiertokiellolla. Promobeez on vaihtokauppa-alusta alkaen 15 €, ja yhteystieto jää sinulle. Malli, kulut, säännöt ja sopivuus vertailussa.
- [Promobeez vs Vaiku](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/promobeez-vs-vaiku): Vaikussa tehdään maksettuja vaikuttajakampanjoita alkaen 149 €/kk. Promobeez on vaihtokauppa-alusta paikallisille yrityksille alkaen 15 €. Hinta tuottajaa kohden, raha vai vaihtokauppa, seuranta ja sopivuus vertailussa.
- [Promobeez vs Invited Agency](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/promobeez-vs-invited): Invited Agency hoitaa vaikuttajayhteistyöt ja PR-tapahtumat puolestasi projektihinnalla. Promobeez on itsepalveluna toimiva vaihtokauppa-alusta alkaen 15 €. Malli, hinta ja sopivuus vertailussa.
- [Vaihtokauppa-alustat Euroopassa: maakohtainen kartta 2026](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/vaihtokauppa-alustat-euroopassa)
- [Miksi yleisö luottaa pieniin sisällöntuottajiin](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/miksi-yleiso-luottaa-pieniin-sisallontuottajiin)
- [Miten valita paikallinen sisällöntuottaja](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/miten-valita-paikallinen-sisallontuottaja)
- [Ravintolan markkinointi Helsingissä](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/ravintolan-markkinointi-helsingissa)
- [Vaikuttajamarkkinoinnin merkintä: KKV:n ohjeet](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/blogi/vaikuttajamarkkinoinnin-merkinta): KKV:n vuoden 2025 ohjeet vaikuttajamarkkinoinnin merkinnästä.

## Product
- [For businesses](https://www.promobeez.com/for-businesses)
- [For creators](https://www.promobeez.com/for-creators)
- [Restaurants](https://www.promobeez.com/influencer-marketing-for-restaurants): Local food creators visit your restaurant and post about it in return for a meal. Post an offer, pick creators by how local their audience is, and pay no agency fee. From €15.
- [Cafés](https://www.promobeez.com/influencer-marketing-for-cafes): Get your café on local creators' feeds in return for coffee, cake or brunch. Post an offer, pick creators whose followers live nearby, pay no agency fee. From €15.
- [Hair & beauty salons](https://www.promobeez.com/influencer-marketing-for-salons): Local creators book a haircut, colour or treatment and post the result in return. Post an offer, pick creators by local audience, pay no agency fee. From €15.
- [Gyms & studios](https://www.promobeez.com/influencer-marketing-for-gyms): Local creators try your gym, yoga or boxing class and post about it in return for a pass. Post an offer, pick creators by local audience, pay no agency fee. From €15.

- [Kahvilat](https://www.promobeez.com/fi/vaikuttajamarkkinointi-kahvilalle)
